title: Cancellable channel fan-in
summary: Merge several inputs, let forwarders stop on cancellation, and close the output only after all senders exit.
code: func merge(ctx context.Context, inputs ...<-chan int) <-chan int {
left, right := make(chan int, 1), make(chan int, 1)
for value := range merge(context.Background(), left, right) {
triggers: fan-in merges concurrent producers onto one channel
context cancellation must unblock both send and receive
prompts: Forward events from several feeds onto one channel until all feeds close.
Allow a consumer that leaves early to cancel forwarders even when one input is idle.
invariant: Forwarders never close the shared output. The closer waits for all forwarders to stop sending before closing it.
mantra: Cancel both waits; join every sender; close once.
pitfalls: Waiting for input with a plain range can leak a forwarder when an input stays open and idle.
A plain send can block forever after the consumer leaves. Upstream producers also need their own cancellation path.
A select can choose a ready value even when cancellation is ready; delivery order across inputs is unspecified.
